description: The 'jobs_cached' dataset provides a comprehensive view of job execution details, capturing metadata and timestamps for various job processes. This dataset is particularly useful for tracking and analyzing job performance, execution times, and outcomes in data processing environments. Each entry in the dataset represents a job instance, identified by unique keys and IDs, and includes information about the job's start and end times, its state, and any warnings generated during execution. Additionally, the dataset records the type and trigger of the job, the initiator, and whether the job required a refresh of the metastore. The dataset also includes detailed output information in JSON format, which specifies the datasets affected by the job. This level of detail makes the dataset valuable for auditing, performance monitoring, and debugging purposes. It can be used by data engineers and analysts to optimize job scheduling, identify bottlenecks, and ensure data integrity across projects.
shortDesc: Dataset of cached job details with timestamps and metadata.

columns.name: job_project_key
columns.comment: Unique key for the job's project, identifies project.

columns.name: job_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each job, tracks job instance.

columns.name: time_start
columns.comment: Timestamp when the job started, marks job initiation.

columns.name: time_end
columns.comment: Timestamp when the job ended, marks job completion.

columns.name: stable_state
columns.comment: Indicates if job reached a stable state, boolean flag.

columns.name: state
columns.comment: Current state of the job, e.g., 'DONE'.

columns.name: warnings_count
columns.comment: Number of warnings generated during job execution.

columns.name: scenario_project_key
columns.comment: Key for the scenario's project, links to project.

columns.name: scenario_id
columns.comment: Identifier for the scenario, tracks scenario instance.

columns.name: scenario_run_id
columns.comment: ID for the scenario run, tracks execution instance.

columns.name: step_id
columns.comment: Identifier for the job step, tracks step instance.

columns.name: step_run_id
columns.comment: ID for the step run, tracks execution instance.

columns.name: job_def_trigger_type
columns.comment: Trigger type for job definition, e.g., 'SCHEDULER'.

columns.name: job_def_initiator
columns.comment: User who initiated the job, tracks initiator.

columns.name: job_def_initiated
columns.comment: Timestamp when job was initiated, marks initiation.

columns.name: job_def_refresh_metastore
columns.comment: Indicates if metastore refresh was required, boolean.

columns.name: job_def_outputs
columns.comment: JSON array of job outputs, details affected datasets.
